brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: Build has 3 full bases (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) plus notch:0#1,1#notch2 drawer-frame at 1,1 level0. No drawer part is present; find_sockets for drawer returns 0 sockets. A half-base configuration is needed for drawer insertion but not offered by configurator.

requirements.requirement: Spike at corner where three bases meet to hold small platform
requirements.evidence: Three bases meet at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 which does offer spike socket s102. Previously a mount spike with platform-sm was placed and verified, but removed to test vertical stacking; currently no spike/platform is present due to SPIKE_CLASH with upper storey. Socket is available to re-add mount spike + platform-sm.

finish.summary: Build is 3 full bases forming compact L-shape with notch drawer frame at 1,1. Mesh clear, but drawer insertion not offered and spike/platform currently removed (socket remains available). Both brief requirements are not fully embodied in current build.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
